Used to reassemble sections printed across page boundaries.
Glue the shaded tab over the matching Align dashed line.
FPP Pattern | For personal use only.
Exact template shapes (0.25" seam allowance included), planned on 40.0" usable Width of Fabric (WOF).
Sections G, L, P are delivered as FPP FOUNDATIONS - their rough-cut estimates include 3/4" padding and are
included in each fabric's total below.
Square/rectangle pieces are listed below but not printed as templates (cut them straight from these
Pieces cut via technique squares (stitch-and-flip corners, batch HSTs, flying geese) are fully specified below
and are not printed as shape templates.
A2: stitch-and-flip corner 1½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
A4: stitch-and-flip corner 2½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
B1: stitch-and-flip corner 2½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
B3: stitch-and-flip corner 2½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
B4: stitch-and-flip corner 2½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
C5: stitch-and-flip corner 2" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
C7: stitch-and-flip corner 2" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
F3: stitch-and-flip corner 1½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
I1: stitch-and-flip corner 3½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
I3: stitch-and-flip corner 3½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
M1: stitch-and-flip corner 3" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
O3: stitch-and-flip corner 1½" square; sew on the diagonal, trim to ¼" SA (bonus HST possible from the trimmed
! D1: stitch-and-flip not applied (the selected base pieces leave a gap along the corner seam - include every
piece the corner flips onto); cut as template.
Fabric BL1 (#0e232e) - 1 piece - total 1¼" x WOF - suggested: Fat Eighth (FE)
Cut 1 strip 1¼" x WOF (uses 1¼"); subcut 1¼" square [C2].
Fabric BR1 (#804d00) - 4 pieces - total 10" x WOF - suggested: Fat Quarter (FQ)
Cut 1 strip 6½" x WOF (uses 15¼"); subcut 8½" x 6½" rectangle [B2]; 1⅞" wide tri [O1]; 4⅞" wide tri [D1].
Cut 1 strip 3½" x WOF (uses 10½"); subcut 10½" x 3½" rectangle [I2].
Fabric PK1 (#d33682) - 20 pieces - total 15½" x WOF - suggested: 0.500 yd (4/8 yd)
Cut 1 strip 3½" x WOF (uses 7"); subcut 2 x 3½" square [I1, I3].
Cut 1 strip 3" x WOF (uses 3"); subcut 3" square [M1].
Cut 1 strip 2½" x WOF (uses 13½"); subcut 3½" x 2½" rectangle [A3]; 4 x 2½" square [A4, B1, B3, B4].
Cut 1 strip 2" x WOF (uses 14"); subcut 7½" x 2" rectangle [F1]; 2½" x 2" rectangle [F4]; 2 x 2" square [C5,
Cut 1 strip 1½" x WOF (uses 33"); subcut 2 x 16½" x 1½" rectangle [H1, J1].
Cut 1 strip 1½" x WOF (uses 31"); subcut 2 x 15½" x 1½" rectangle [I1, K1].
Cut 1 strip 1½" x WOF (uses 15"); subcut 10½" x 1½" rectangle [I4]; 3 x 1½" square [A2, F3, O3].
Fabric OR1 (#f37329) - 8 pieces - total 5⅝" x WOF - suggested: Fat Eighth (FE)
Cut 1 strip 2¼" x WOF (uses 4½"); subcut 2 x 2¼" square [J1, J2].
FPP foundation sections: allow 3⅜" x WOF (6 rough-cut pieces, 3/4" padding included).
Fabric OR2 (#fdf6e3) - 11 pieces - total 12" x WOF - suggested: Fat Quarter (FQ)
Cut 1 strip 2½" x WOF (uses 13⅝"); subcut 5½" x 2½" rectangle [C4]; 2½" square [A1]; 5⅝" wide odd [K1].
Cut 1 strip 2" x WOF (uses 16⅜"); subcut 8" x 2" rectangle [N1]; 8⅜" wide odd [O2].
Cut 1 strip 1¾" x WOF (uses 11"); subcut 2 x 5½" x 1¾" rectangle [C6, H1].
Cut 1 strip 1½" x WOF (uses 2"); subcut 2" x 1½" rectangle [F2].
Cut 1 strip 1¼" x WOF (uses 5¼"); subcut 3¼" x 1¼" rectangle [C3]; 2" x 1¼" rectangle [C1].
From a 3" length of full-width fabric, cut the remaining 1 shape(s) as laid out in the map.
Fabric OR3 (#fef6e3) - 7 pieces - total 3⅜" x WOF - suggested: Fat Eighth (FE)
